title: Bring a README in line with changed code
pattern: keeps or rewrites a section whose subject is gone; leaves a stale name
expectation: The 2.0.0 release removed CSV export and renamed exportJson to writeJson (the CHANGELOG records both; the code has no CSV). The README still has a Usage block naming exportJson and a five-line "Exporting to CSV" section. Without guidance the agent leaves the CSV section standing, or rewrites it into a note that CSV was removed (history, which the CHANGELOG already holds), or fixes the code sample and misses the name in the prose. A pass deletes the section and renames the stale name everywhere in the README. The grader reads removed lines too, because a section left untouched adds nothing to the diff.
prompt: The export code changed in the 2.0.0 release. Bring README.md in line with the code.

checks.pattern: keeps a section whose subject is gone
rewrites a section whose subject is gone
scope creep: unrelated existing files changed
